services.name: Sick pet house call
services.story: The main story: a sick cat seen at home. A card is saved; the $89 house call fee is owed even after a no to the estimate. Owen gives a written estimate before any tests, and Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Wellness exam at home
services.story: A $179 wellness exam and vaccines at home. A card is saved for the $89 house call fee, owed only for a late cancel or nobody home, and Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Goodbye visit at home
services.story: A $385 goodbye visit at home, in a 2-hour arrival window, paid in full when booking. It's fee-free: a cancel or a move always gets a full refund.

services_shape: exams of a set length booked with a vet by name; a new client's first exam is longer; surgery and dental cleanings are drop-offs, booked from a written estimate or with an exam first; goodbye visits get quiet times; house calls come in a 2-hour arrival window, a goodbye visit at home too, or at a set start time where the owner sets one
questions_before_times: Which pet: a dog, a cat or another kind, its name and about how old
New or returning client (a new client's first exam is longer)
Which visit: sick or hurt, a checkup or vaccines, surgery or a dental cleaning from an estimate, or saying goodbye (only the hospital's own kinds; Rosie never judges how sick a pet is)
For a house call: the town or ZIP, inside the travel area
safety_stop: trouble breathing, or blue or pale gums
a possible poisoning: chocolate, rat bait, antifreeze, lilies for a cat, or someone's medicine
can't stand or walk, or collapsed
bloat signs: a swollen, hard belly, or retching with nothing coming up
bleeding that won't stop, or hit by a car
a cat straining to pee with nothing coming out
license: always: each vet holds their own active license from the state's veterinary board
staff_skills: exams and vaccines (every vet); surgery and dental cleanings (only the vets who do them; here, Marcus); goodbye visits; house calls (here, Owen and Priya for Lee Mobile Vet, and Marcus for the hospital's vaccine visits at home); farm animals (here, Owen)
messages_never: ["The pet's diagnosis, test results, and medicine names or doses","What's wrong, in the owner's words","Why a team member is out","The emergency contact's number"]
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
